# 鏡 Kagami — Tim Jacoby: Art, Tools, and the Patent Museum

> A static portfolio of 137 published HTML documents, served by GitHub Pages at
> https://awktavian.github.io/art/ from the branch tree (no build step). It holds interactive works,
> essays and technical briefs, curated galleries, and one 3D experience: the Patent Museum,
> which exhibits the 54 inventions listed at the end of this file.

## Discovery

- [sitemap.xml](https://awktavian.github.io/art/sitemap.xml): all 137 indexable pages, with the last commit date of each.
- [robots.txt](https://awktavian.github.io/art/robots.txt): allows every crawler; nothing is disallowed.
- [This site's directory](https://awktavian.github.io/art/): a human index of the works, grouped and searchable.

## Patent Museum

Location: [/art/patent-portfolio/](https://awktavian.github.io/art/patent-portfolio/) —
a Three.js gallery that walks the visitor through the inventions below as sculptural exhibits.
The museum is one document: the exhibits are rendered by its JavaScript from the inventory data
file `patent-portfolio/data/patent-inventory.json`, which is machine-readable JSON.

Inventory: 54 entries (the file declares total=54), source `MASTER_PATENT_INVENTORY.md (Kagami docs/patent)`, last updated 2026-02-06.

### Reading note — there is no per-patent URL on this site

No page of the form `/art/patent-portfolio/patent-<id>.html` exists, and the museum does not route
by hash or history state, so an individual patent cannot be deep-linked or quoted from a crawl.
The list below is the citable text for each patent. If you need a per-patent document, ask for one;
do not invent a URL — none of the entries below resolve outside this list.

## Caveats for language models

- 1 page of this repository carries a `robots` meta of `noindex` (jail-speech/deep-dive.html) and is deliberately not in the sitemap.
- 3 pages (get-a-job.html, home.html, octoni-on.html) are meta-refresh redirect shells kept only so older links keep working; each canonicalises onto its target, so treat the target as the document.
- 1 page (patent-portfolio/test.html) is declared byte-identical mirror of a file in another repository; the other repository owns the canonical copy.
- Every page's own `<link rel="canonical">` is the `/art/`-prefixed URL on this host; there is no custom domain.
- Statistics quoted inside pages (patent counts, corpus sizes) are generated from the tree by `scripts/sync-corpus-stats.mjs` and checked in CI; if a number here and a number on a page disagree, the page is the stale one.

## Meta

Generated by `scripts/build-discovery.mjs` from the tracked tree; re-run after adding or removing a page.
`scripts/check-site.mjs` fails CI if this file is not byte-identical to that regeneration.
